notes: Section 11, 1935 edition, 5400x4142. 1-bit photocopy. Frame on all four sides: thick speckled bar, white gap, thin inner rule (innermost, ~4 px); corner arcs (thick + thin) in all four corners, each thin arc joined to the side rules by a short connector (a ~6-10 px joggle). Rule 1: the outline lies ~1.5-2 px inside the thin rule's inner edge, fitted locally (+-80 px) so it follows the rule's bows, points <= 150 px apart; the 1-bit rule edge is ragged, so single px of the rule's edge touch the outline in places. Rule 2: the outline follows the thin arc's inner edge (~2 px inside, points <= 30 px apart) and steps round each connector on its map side, so arcs, connectors and everything beyond them are outside. The page is turned ~0.7 deg: thin rule's inner edge top y 380 (x 500) -> 430 (x 4840), bottom 3964 -> 4047, left x 267 (y 600) -> 226 (y 3735), right 5075 -> 5036; the left rule has a local dent of ~4 px to the left round y 2880-2960, which the outline follows. Arc radii TL ~171, TR ~221, BL ~208, BR ~208 (not exact circles: the tails run straight into the connectors). Connector steps at TL x 496 / y 594, TR x 4847 / y 656, BR y 3830 / x 4811, BL x 451 / y 3738. Kind b (map ink truly touches the rule; the outline follows the rule's inner edge through it, the edge there taken as the rule's clean outer edge + its thickness): this sheet is hatched to the frame, so 228 of the outline's 328 stretches hold ink. Left side: hatched and gridded blocks are fused to the rule for most of y ~1000-2910 and block lines touch it at y ~3000-3740. Top: block lines and solid blocks at x ~1700-3050 and x ~4350-4410. Right: block lines along the rule at y ~1065-1090 and ~1340-1370 (a map line 1 px inside the rule) and crossing lines down to y ~3240. Bottom: hatch lines and a solid block (x ~2845-2895) nearly all along. TR arc: the thin and thick arcs are fused for ~20 px at ~5005,510 (a street line ends there); BL arc and its bottom connector: gridded block lines run into the arc and the connector (x ~405-460). Doubt: a pasted grey (stippled) patch covers the bottom rule and ~12 px of map above it at x ~1712-1864 (its top edge y ~3974); no rule is visible there, so the outline runs straight across it from the rule either side (1702,3982.8 -> 1878,3986.0), not round the patch. 'Join Sec. 12 / 9 / 10' print outside the frame. Remove (rule 4): remove[0] the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP / PREPARED BY / CITY PLANNING COMMISSION / 1935 / R.S. WOODWARD title, LEGEND with its six swatches and labels, and the scale bar with its SCALE lettering (lower right; no ruled box; ink x 4362-5018, y 3240-3926). Map ink presses on it from the top and left, so the outline (20 points) threads the paper gaps instead of being a box: along the swatches' top it runs in a 3 px gap (y 3238) under two street-line ends; the top steps down to y 3297 right of the swatches (block ink ends at y ~3234 there); on the right it runs between the CITY & COUNTY line and the right rule / BR arc tail (2-5 px from each at y ~3870-3886); at the bottom it steps up over the SECTION badge; on the left it follows the scale bar, bulges out round SCALE (a 4 px gap between the lettering and a solid sliver block, x 4360.5) and steps in again above the bar so that the two street lines ending at ~4406,3346 and ~4371,3445 stay map. No ink under it. remove[1] the compass rose (ink x 3785-4005, y 3632-3905), turned 90 deg, with its tail and feather (x 3471-3530, y 3747-3769), the true-north needle (tip ~4303,3779) and the magnetic needle with its flag (tip ~4281,3892); 18 points. THE COMPASS IS PRINTED AMONG THE BLOCKS, in a pocket of blank paper between street and block lines, not in open water: it overprints no map ink, but map ink is close on every side (a block line 6 px from the feather's tip, which the outline passes in a 7 px gap at 3468,3745; street-line ends ~20-30 px above the rose and ~18-26 px above and below the tail). The outline hugs the tail as a ~30 px strip so those lines stay map; the paper between the two needles is taken with them. No ink under it. remove[2] the SECTION 11 badge (ring centre 4906,3918, radius 59), an octagon 5 px outside the ring, on paper between the title block and the BR arc. Not removed: street names, block numbers, BAY VIEW PARK, OLD LADIES HOME, RESERVOIR.
drawn_by: Claude (LB training labels, issue #71), on full-resolution crops and ASCII dumps of the scan only, 2026-11-21: side rules measured on every 2nd px (the thin rule's clean outer edge + its own thickness wherever map ink is fused to it), corner arcs traced along the thin arc's inner edge, connector steps and remove polygons placed from pixel dumps; every vertex checked close up; ink check run
